name: Modern SEO - Module 2 Three-Step Method
body:
> Course · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Module 2 (4 lessons, about 34 minutes of video, about 28 minutes of speech) puts the three-step low competition ranking method from M1L5 into practice over the shoulder on one business, Right Way Driving School in Cedar Grove, NJ. Lesson 1 is the GBP audit, Lesson 2 the GBP landing page audit, Lesson 3 verified citations, and Lesson 4 the timelines, success measure and the decision point for Core 30.

# Lessons
- [Modern SEO - M2L1 Complete GBP Audit and Optimization](lib:brain-modern-seo-m2l1-complete-gbp-audit-and-optimization): rank map first, then categories and every field, services sorted with a Claude prompt, GBP Review document plus client questionnaire, no change until approval.
- [Modern SEO - M2L2 GBP Landing Page Audit and Optimization](lib:brain-modern-seo-m2l2-gbp-landing-page-audit-and-optimization): title tag and H1 with primary category + city, NAP match, LocalBusiness schema, area content, map and reviews embeds, tel: links; add content, do not delete.
- [Modern SEO - M2L3 Citations and Trust Signals that Work](lib:brain-modern-seo-m2l3-citations-and-trust-signals-that-work): LeadSnap setup, sync details from the GBP, $20 per month per location citation subscription after approval, how to read listing statuses.
- [Modern SEO - M2L4 Putting it All Together](lib:brain-modern-seo-m2l4-putting-it-all-together): 1 to 2 weeks to implement, 20 to 40% top 3 target in 1 to 2 months, stuck at 10 to 15% after two months means Core 30.

# Combined process
1. Baseline rank map (primary category + city, or "near me").
2. Audit the GBP; sort services into categories with no repeats.
3. Send the GBP Review and questionnaire; wait for approval.
4. Make approved GBP changes (categories directly in the GBP).
5. A few days later, audit the landing page; get permission; hand fixes to the developer; add content.
6. Sync details into the citation tool, fill every field, turn on citations after approval.
7. Keep the GBP active: weekly photos and posts, reviews, Q&A.
8. Optional offsite: chamber of commerce, offsite analysis prompt, local charity sponsorship.
9. Track every 1 to 2 weeks with a dated change log.
10. At about two months, stay the course or move to Core 30.

# Caveats
- All timelines, percentages and the 70 to 80% figure are instructor claims.
- LeadSnap is paid ($20 per month per location as stated). TAG needs Kim's approval before any paid service.
- Lessons 2 and 3 end with long silent stretches; nothing seems lost.
